name: ownmetrics-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your own Garmin data, via Garmin's official Personal API. Read-only, runs on your computer. Unofficial; not affiliated with Garmin.
long_description: OwnMetrics lets Claude answer questions about your own sleep, HRV, stress, Body Battery, heart rate and activities, using Garmin's official Personal API and a key you create in Garmin Connect. It is read-only, talks only to Garmin, stores no health data, and never reports missing data as zero. Results are informational, not medical advice. Unofficial project: not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Garmin. "Garmin" and "Garmin Connect" are trademarks of Garmin Ltd. or its subsidiaries.

tools.name: get_daily_overview
tools.description: One day's overview: steps, distance, floors, resting/min/max heart rate, stress, Body Battery, calories, intensity minutes, sleep hours and sleep score.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Sleep per night over a date range: hours, deep/light/REM/awake minutes, sleep score, Garmin's feedback, average heart rate, respiration and sleep stress. Each night is labelled woke_up_on, the morning it ended.

tools.name: get_hrv
tools.description: Heart rate variability (HRV) per night over a date range: last-night average, weekly average, 5-minute high, status and personal baseline, in milliseconds. Each night is labelled woke_up_on, the morning it ended.

tools.name: get_stress_and_body_battery
tools.description: Per day over a date range: average stress (0-100), minutes in each stress band, and Body Battery high, low, charged and drained.

tools.name: get_heart_rate
tools.description: One day's heart rate (resting, min, max, 7-day resting average) and the user's heart rate zones.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: List activities in a date range, newest first, optionally filtered by Garmin activity type key (e.g. running, cycling, indoor_cycling, lap_swimming, strength_training). Returns ids for get_activity.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Details of one activity by id: duration, distance, pace, speed, heart rate, power, cadence, training effect and load, splits and structured workout steps.

tools.name: get_body_metrics
tools.description: Body metrics over a date range: weigh-ins (kg), BMI, body fat, hydration; plus Pulse Ox (SpO2) and fitness age as of the end date.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Check the Garmin connection: whether the key works, granted scopes, a warning if the key expires within a day, which data areas respond, and what Garmin does not provide. Use this first when something fails.

tools.name: training_summary
tools.description: Training totals over up to 366 days, by week or month: sessions, hours, hours per week, evening sessions, average aerobic training effect, and a per-sport breakdown. Use for 'how much did I train' questions.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Compare two periods (each up to 366 days), e.g. this October vs last October: average sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, stress, Body Battery, steps and training per week, with change and % change and how many days of data each side has.

tools.name: recovery_correlations
tools.description: Does training go with better or worse sleep and HRV? Over up to 366 days, pairs each day's training with the night after it: correlations with sample size and strength, plus averages for training vs rest days and evening vs earlier sessions. Can focus on one sport. Correlation is not cause; say so when answering.

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Trend of one metric over up to 366 days, by day, week or month: the series, change per 30 days and whether it is going up, down or flat. Daily grouping adds a 7-day rolling average.

tools.name: weekly_review
tools.description: Weekly review, the same every time: training, sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, stress and Body Battery for the Monday-to-Sunday week containing week_of (default: this week so far), against the same days last week and the previous 28 days; best and worst nights; and highlights from fixed rules. Use for 'weekly review' or 'how was my week' questions. For a general weekly review, call it once with no week_of; pass week_of only when the user names a week (e.g. 'last week').

garmin_api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
garmin_api_key.description: Create it in Garmin Connect: Settings, Personal API. Leave blank if you already saved a key with `ownmetrics-mcp auth`.
